series: Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, Reason #16 (out of sight)
hook: You didn't quit your goal. You just stopped seeing it.

gate.goal_link: keeps a big goal in daily attention so its weekly step actually happens
gate.mechanism: attention goes to what is in front of you; a goal stored in a notes app has no daily cue, so it drops out of mind by week 3 (shown as days-you-thought-about-it bars, illustrative)
gate.universal: almost everyone has a goal written somewhere they never look

frame.mistake: the goal lives in a notes app nobody opens
frame.cost: 7 days a week in week 1 -> 0 by week 4 (illustrative, labelled as days you thought about it)
frame.fix: goal + this week's one step on the lock screen; Sunday 2-min update

hooks_considered.line: You didn't quit your goal. You just stopped seeing it.
hooks_considered.checks: hard truth Y, gap Y, muted Y (bars fall to 0), sendable Y, payoff Y

hooks_considered.line: By week three, you'll forget your own goal.
hooks_considered.checks: good, a prediction more than a truth

hooks_considered.line: Your goal lives in a notes app you never open.
Three weeks after you set a goal, it's gone from your day.
Out of sight, out of goals.

beats.hard_truth: 0.0 s, bars Week 1 7 days -> Week 4 0 days on frame 0
beats.rehook_10: bars grow week by week to the red zero
beats.rehook_20: notes app with the goal note '23 days ago' buried under notifications, then the lock screen typed
